note: All billed token classes per provider; copy to prices-<date>.json and pin. Cache writes are TWO keys, not one: costing.py bills usage.cache_creation_tokens at cache_write_1h (2x base input on the Anthropic card), and cache_write_5m (1.25x) is carried so the rate is on the record for the 5m class the collector leaves deliberately unmapped. Do NOT collapse them back into a single `cache_write` key — that key exists only as a legacy fallback for snapshots predating the 2026-08-16 split, and a lone key silently picks a TTL.
